 class TestMin:

 class TestMax:
     def test_max(self):

+        assert ms.max(env, (1, 2)) == 2

+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('filter_name, expected', [('min', 'small'), ('max', 'large')])
+def test_extrema_attribute_in_template(filter_name, expected):
+    template_env = Environment()
+    template_env.filters[filter_name] = getattr(ms, filter_name)
+    values = [{'name': 'large', 'size': 10}, {'name': 'small', 'size': 1}]
+    template = template_env.from_string('{{ (values | %s(attribute="size")).name }}' % filter_name)
+    assert template.render(values=values) == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('filter_name, expected', [('min', 'B'), ('max', 'a')])
+def test_extrema_case_sensitive(filter_name, expected):
+    assert getattr(ms, filter_name)(env, ['a', 'B'], case_sensitive=True) == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('filter_name', ['min', 'max'])
+def test_extrema_forwards_all_keyword_arguments(monkeypatch, filter_name):
+    calls = []
+
+    def jinja_filter(environment, value, **kwargs):
+        calls.append((environment, value, kwargs))
+        return value[0]
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ms, 'do_' + filter_name, jinja_filter)
+    values = [{'size': 1}]
+    assert getattr(ms, filter_name)(env, values, attribute='size', case_sensitive=True, extra=True) == values[0]
+    assert calls == [(env, values, {'attribute': 'size', 'case_sensitive': True, 'extra': True})]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('filter_name, availability', [('min', 'HAS_MIN'), ('max', 'HAS_MAX')])
+def test_extrema_fallback_without_jinja(monkeypatch, filter_name, availability):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ms, availability, False)
+    filter_func = getattr(ms, filter_name)
+    assert filter_func(env, [2, 1]) == (1 if filter_name == 'min' else 2)
+    message = ("Ansible's %s filter does not support any keyword arguments. "
+               "You need Jinja2 2.10 or later that provides their version of the filter." % filter_name)
+    with pytest.raises(AnsibleFilterError) as error:
+        filter_func(env, [2, 1], attribute='size')
+    assert error.value.message == message
